rows.grounds: fused form of dakṣiṇāya (to the southern one) and namaḥ (homage); sandhi noted, token kept whole
fused form of vāmanāya (to Vāmana/the dwarf) and namaḥ (homage); sandhi noted, token kept whole
fused form of siddhayogine (to the accomplished yogin; siddha+yogin) and namaḥ (homage); sandhi noted, token kept whole

items.question: To which southern, dwarf, and accomplished yogic forms is reverential homage directed?
premises: Homage is directed to the southern form.
Homage is directed to the dwarf form.
Homage is directed to the accomplished yogin.
items.inference: These epithets designate specific recipients of ritual salutation.
uncertainties: Whether dakṣiṇāya refers to a directional aspect or a specific deity name is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Homage to the Southern One, homage to Vāmana, homage to the accomplished yogin.
